title: Add Standalone Payroll Tax Calculator (Australia, India, USA, UK, Custom)

requirements.text: Create a new standalone PayrollTaxCalculator component at `frontend/src/components/tabs/PayrollTaxCalculatorTab.tsx` that accepts the following inputs: gross salary (numeric), pay frequency (weekly / fortnightly / monthly / annually), allowances (numeric, optional), superannuation/pension contribution (numeric as percentage, optional), and region selector (Australia, India, USA, UK, Custom/Generic).

quotes: gross salary, pay frequency (weekly/fortnightly/monthly), allowances, superannuation/pension contributions, tax brackets a custom/generic setup and Australia, India, USA, UK a standalone calculator tool

acceptanceCriteria: Region selector shows exactly 5 options: Australia, India, USA, UK, Custom/Generic
Pay frequency dropdown includes Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Annually
Gross salary, allowances, and super/pension fields are present and accept numeric input
All inputs are validated (e.g., salary must be positive)

requirements.text: Implement region-specific tax calculation logic within the PayrollTaxCalculatorTab component for all five regions: (1) Australia — ATO progressive income tax brackets (FY 2024-25), Medicare levy (2%), employer superannuation (11% default, editable); (2) India — both Old and New tax regime options (FY 2024-25), standard deduction, Provident Fund (PF) contribution, health and education cess (4%); (3) USA — federal progressive income tax brackets (2024), FICA Social Security (6.2% up to wage base) and Medicare (1.45%), and a flat/generic state tax rate field; (4) UK — PAYE tax bands (2024-25: Personal Allowance £12,570, Basic 20%, Higher 40%, Additional 45%), National Insurance Class 1 employee contributions; (5) Custom/Generic — user-defined tax brackets (add/remove rows with income threshold and rate %), flat deduction rate, and flat pension/super rate.

quotes: Australia — Income tax brackets (ATO), Medicare levy (2%), superannuation (11% employer)
India — New & old tax regime options, PF contributions, standard deduction
USA — Federal income tax brackets, FICA (Social Security + Medicare), state tax (flat/generic)
UK — PAYE tax bands, National Insurance contributions (NI)
Custom/Generic — User-defined tax brackets and deduction rates

acceptanceCriteria: Switching region updates the tax calculation logic and relevant input fields
Australia: Medicare levy and super are applied correctly
India: toggling Old vs New regime recalculates tax using the correct slabs
USA: FICA components (Social Security + Medicare) are shown separately; a state tax rate input is present
UK: NI contributions are calculated and displayed separately from income tax
Custom/Generic: user can add/remove tax bracket rows; calculation uses those brackets

requirements.text: Display a detailed results breakdown after calculation, showing all of the following per selected pay period and annually: Gross Pay, Allowances, Taxable Income, Income Tax, region-specific deductions (e.g., Medicare Levy, Super/Pension, NI, FICA Social Security, FICA Medicare, PF, state tax), Total Deductions, and Net (Take-Home) Pay. Format all monetary values in the appropriate currency for the selected region (AUD, INR, USD, GBP; use USD for Custom).

quotes: Breakdown showing gross pay, tax withheld, deductions, and net (take-home) pay per pay period and annually

acceptanceCriteria: Results section shows both per-period and annual figures side by side
Each deduction line is labeled clearly and shows the correct computed value
Net take-home pay equals gross pay minus all deductions
Currency symbol matches the selected region (AUD, INR, USD, GBP)
Results update immediately when any input changes

requirements.text: Add the PayrollTaxCalculatorTab as a new tab entry in the existing Dashboard tab navigation in `frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`. Place it within an appropriate tab group (Finance or Operations). The tab label should be 'Payroll Tax Calculator'.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Payroll Tax Calculator' tab is visible and clickable in the dashboard navigation
Clicking the tab renders the PayrollTaxCalculatorTab component
No existing tabs are removed or broken

requirements.text: Style the PayrollTaxCalculatorTab to match the existing app design system (saffron/emerald OKLCH tokens, Tailwind utility classes, shadcn UI primitives, dark mode support). Use card-based layout with a left/top input panel and a right/bottom results panel. Use distinct visual sections for each deduction category in the results breakdown. Include a 'Calculate' button as well as live recalculation on input change.
acceptanceCriteria: Component uses existing CSS custom property tokens and shadcn components
Dark mode renders correctly without color contrast issues
Layout is responsive and usable on both desktop and mobile viewports
Results panel clearly separates income tax, statutory deductions, and net pay

constraints: All tax calculation logic must be implemented purely in the frontend (no backend changes required)
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Do not alter existing tab components or backend/main.mo
nonGoals: Payroll record persistence to the backend
Integration with the existing PayrollTab (employee management, pay slips, Form 16)
PDF export of payroll tax results (not requested)
